approved_by_user: 98 percent minimum download coverage and correctness for eligible dataset scopes
scope: 2026-09 pilot, then eligible monthly Bronze and Silver by dataset/date/market; listed and OTC analysis, emerging save-only

default_thresholds.rounding: compare exact numerator/denominator fractions; display rounded metrics only

definitions.expected_unit: A contracted source-dataset-period-market unit that should exist under that source's official trading, reporting and release calendar; exclude proven closures, not-yet-due and source-not-offered items; unknown scope not included or silently deemed complete
definitions.valid_download: Immutable native bytes can be read back, SHA256 matches, ZIP CRC passes if applicable, correct source/period, source ID and provenance
definitions.valid_content: Expected schema and required field types, valid date and stock identity, no unisolated critical errors; legitimate null/nontrading values are classified, not changed to zero
definitions.denominator: Expected due units for approved active dataset scope, never downloaded files or total possible website resources
definitions.correctness: valid_expected_content_records / inspectable_expected_content_records; requires a declared market/dataset sampling or exhaustive method and no known-critical violations
definitions.missing: confirmed expected due unit with no accepted original or equivalent, record as missing; official retry is not proof of absence
definitions.unknown: No credible scope or calendar denominator. Mark UNKNOWN rather than 0% or 100%.

dataset_release.unknown_scope_policy: UNKNOWN datasets or unmapped indicators must not block independent PASS dataset scopes; unknown/unmapped itself cannot be called 98% PASS
dataset_release.release_prohibition: Do not set global production RELEASE_APPROVED merely because policy was changed; no approval until measured evidence and targeted gate, separate authorization for actual promotion

hard_stops.bad_sha256_or_zip_crc: QUARANTINE individual file; never accept corrupted bytes even if aggregate >=98%
hard_stops.wrong_stock_id_or_date_or_market: QUARANTINE affected records and dependent signals
hard_stops.lookahead_or_unknown_published_at: BLOCK PIT-sensitive signals using those observations; retain native Bronze with PIT_UNKNOWN
hard_stops.entire_market_day_absent: BLOCK dependent market/date analysis irrespective of monthly percentage
hard_stops.critical_reference_data_missing: BLOCK dependent analytics while unaffected scopes can release
hard_stops.legal_null_no_trades: not automatically invalid; source-specific semantics required
hard_stops.schema_breaking: QUARANTINE affected dataset family until schema version accounted
hard_stops.required_original_source_absent: source scoped partial; do not manufacture FinMind pseudo-official

retry.http429: honor Retry-After and source rate limit instead of hammering

silver_policy: May transform only PASS_98 scoped Bronze; PARTIAL may transform explicitly verified subscopes with warnings, disabled affected indicators, no global 443-indicator dependency requirement
gold_policy: Only compute features whose full lookback, source unit, provenance, market identity, PIT and required dependencies are satisfied; disabled features stay disabled
